title: Detecting sleeper agents hiding in AI model neurons
description: Microsoft Research has identified a threat where AI agent models can be backdoored by modifying fewer than 10 neurons to embed a sleeper agent payload. This backdoored model passes normal evaluations but executes attacker commands when triggered by a specific string. The threat is significant because AI agents often run unattended with privileged access, making model weight integrity critical. Microsoft has not observed this technique used in the wild but recommends auditing model weights, using AI auditors, securing model hubs, and applying runtime protections to mitigate risk.
